method: Same real GGUF gate/up benchmark as the prior codebook screen; 8 experts,640rows,2560columns,1/2/3/4/8tokens; five alternating paired trials and five eight-expert passes per sample; warm weights, synthetic Q8_K activations, finite and bitwise comparisons first. variants.j: Disable unrolling the outer four-iteration loop; retain the two-half inner unroll.
variants.both: Disable both j and half unrolling.
variants.acc2: Disable j unroll and use separate integer accumulators per half.

raw_csv_note: gather=0 unchanged baseline, gather=1 named candidate; no candidate changes codebook lookup strategy.

selected_count_expression.change: For Clang znver3, pragma unroll_count(TY==21 ? 1 : 4). Explicit count4 changes the generated IQ3_XXS code and slows NT2/3/4 by about15-17%; do not assume it retains the default heuristic. Isolate IQ3_S in a dedicated helper instead.

isolated_iq3s.scope: Dedicated IQ3_S helper on Clang when __znver3__ is defined; other types keep their original helper and compiler loop heuristics. Existing STRATA_CPU_ARCH=znver3 activates this on the measured build.

pairs.method: Six processes in old1/new1/new2/old2/old3/new3 order; same production config and PACK0, SYCL persistent cache0/driver cache1; writing+coding128 tokens twice each then prefill/decode cancellation and8-token recovery; strict completed-ID comparison. No compilation, separate benchmark or GPU tests overlapped timing.

validation.actual_object_all_nt: 1..8, real IQ3_XXS/IQ3_S weights, all outputs finite and bitwise equal to old code recompiled in another namespace;160 timing samples. Those timings use a recompiled reference, not the exact previous engine object.
